name: Polonizer for WooCommerce
author: patrykowsky

sections.description:
Polonizer for WooCommerce is a lightweight and modern plugin optimized for improving the checkout conversion rate for stores operating in Poland.

Main Free Features:

  • NIP Field for Companies: Beautifully integrates a clean and safe NIP input field into the billing details section.
  • Polish Address Layout: Automatically places the postcode and city fields in one row (50%/50% width) before the street field for perfect UX.
  • Remove State/Region: Automatically hides the redundant state field, drastically shortening the checkout form.
  • Autocleanup for Virtual Products: Automatically hides physical address lines when a customer buys digital products like e-books or online courses.
  • Modern Admin Dashboard: Enable or disable each feature with beautiful toggle switches.

Want full automation? Upgrade to Polonizer PRO to unlock instant business data fetching directly from national registries (White List / GUS) after typing a NIP number, alongside live mathematical validation!
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins -> Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Polonizer for WooCommerce or upload the .zip archive.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Access the custom Polonizer settings tab to adjust options.
sections.changelog:
1.3.2

  • Fix: Hardened CSS module removing layout-breaking default labels from specific themes.
  • Fix: Safe country filter injection for frictionless virtual product checkout flows.
  • New: Full support for the PRO extension and seamless integration with naffy payments.
